summary: A split-screen, two-colour (blue and white) site that stages the variable font Pleasure (wght, ital and an inktrap axis TRAP) as the flyers of a fictional prepaid-phone and repair shop. The left column scrolls down while the right column scrolls up in the opposite direction, and cloned panels make the page loop. Many flyers are editable, one panel has axis sliders, and a phone keypad on the right lets you type with multi-tap.

instances.look: Left half: a glowing duotone photo of a silver flip phone inside a ring of small caps 'NO BLUETOOTH · NO NFC · NO WIFI' on blue; right half (fixed column, seen in the video): the colophon flyer 'PLEASURE TYPEFACE / DESIGNED IN MARSEILLE BY FLIRT(STUDIO) / DEVELOPPED IN PARIS BY PIZZA TYPEFACES / ©2021' with recycle, CC and '1' icons; white pills 'PLEASURE TYPEFACE ?' top-left and 'buy now' top-right
instances.ux: Scrolling moves the two halves in opposite directions at once
instances.learn: Pick a lost everyday object (the dumb phone) as the font's world: its slogans (NO WIFI, PREPAID SIM) give every specimen its copy

reconstruction.layout: Two 50vw columns, each panel 720×973px (≈1.08vh); left panel: phone photo bottom-centre ~400px wide, text ring an ellipse ~640×880px centred; fixed pills 24px from the top-left and top-right

reconstruction.behaviour: #col-2 (right column) is position:fixed and translated with translate3d(0, scrollY − columnHeight, 0) so it moves up while the left column moves down; cloned sections at both ends let the scroll loop

reconstruction.html: left: section.col1-s1 (img layers); right: div#col-2[style=transform] > section.col2-s12.clone

instances.look: A stack of shop-flyer posters in blue and white with glossy gradients and ellipse badges: 'Buy Sell Trade → GSM / All Kinds Of Phones / New & Used / Any Brands*', 'ENJOY THE PLEASURE OF NEW TASTE' in outline caps over a hand with lightning, price stickers ('€1', 'FREE', '€5', '-60%', 'OFFER PERIOD EXPIRED'), a huge '@' blister-pack tab with 'Ple@sure in @ny W@y / M@RSEILLE — P@RIS', 'UNLOCK / REPAIR' running vertically beside a flip phone, a ruled list of phone numbers '+33(0) 622 122 869…', '↘ SLOW DOWN (PLEA-SURE) ↗ UP 2020–2021', 'MADE FOR PLEASURE' on a cloud, 'GUILTY / SMS'; the right column adds 'PIN 1234 PREPAID SIM', 'CONNECTING PEOPLE', 'CRAKED ↔ SCREEN FIX IT', 'INTERNATIONAL SERVICE express 24/24 NON STOP 7/7 N°1', an SMS thread 'Msg (184)' in slang, 'QUICK Delivery 30 minutes guarantee'
instances.ux: The two columns counter-scroll so each screen pairs two different flyers; several headlines are contenteditable; '@' panel swaps a still for an animated GIF
instances.learn: Counter-scrolling columns turn a list of posters into ever-changing pairs; a two-colour duotone keeps very different images feeling like one set
